jobs.title: Fraud Risk Analyst / Financial Crime Analyst
jobs.description:
Role Description
This is a part-time, remote role for a Fraud Risk Analyst / Financial Crime Analyst. The person in this role will monitor and analyze transaction data and customer behavior to identify suspicious patterns, potential fraud, and financial crime risks. They will conduct risk assessments, document findings, and prepare clear reports or alerts for internal stakeholders and compliance teams. Day-to-day tasks include reviewing cases, performing root-cause analysis, supporting investigations, and recommending improvements to fraud detection rules or controls. The role also involves collaborating with cross-functional teams such as operations, compliance, and technology to refine processes and enhance risk mitigation strategies.
Qualifications

Strong Analytical Skills and Risk Analysis capabilities to detect patterns, assess exposure, and support decision-making.
Knowledge of Finance and financial products, with an understanding of how fraud and financial crime can occur in digital financial services.
Familiarity with Statistics and data interpretation to evaluate trends and support quantitative analysis of risk.
Effective Communication skills to present findings clearly, write concise reports, and collaborate with cross-functional teams.
Experience or interest in fraud prevention, anti-money laundering (AML), or financial crime compliance is beneficial.
Ability to work independently in a remote environment, manage time effectively, and handle sensitive information with discretion.
Proficiency with spreadsheets, data analysis tools, or case management systems; experience with SQL or analytics platforms is a plus.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in finance, economics, statistics, data science, criminology, or a related field is preferred.
